website.error: No /pipeline page (404). Corporate site is product-focused (iFuse implant family); no separate clinical pipeline disclosure.

ctgov.note: All SI-BONE-sponsored studies on ClinicalTrials.gov are post-market or observational/N-A phase studies of already-FDA-cleared iFuse devices (e.g. INSITE NCT01681004 Completed; LOIS NCT02270203 Completed; VaReFi NCT01874236 Terminated). No active drug-style P1/P2/P3 trials.

commercial_product.note: SI-BONE is an orthopedic medical device company; products are FDA-cleared/PMA implants for sacroiliac joint, spinopelvic fixation and pelvic trauma. No proprietary drug pipeline. Three platform technologies hold FDA Breakthrough Device designation. >140,000 procedures performed since 2009.
reimbursement_milestones: iFuse TORQ TNT received CMS New Technology Add-on Payment (NTAP) effective Oct 1, 2025 (up to $4,136 incremental hospital reimbursement; expires Sep 30, 2028)
iFuse Bedrock Granite received Transitional Pass-Through (TPT) payment in HOPD/ASC settings effective Jan 1, 2025

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Orthopedic medical-device company (sacroiliac joint and spinopelvic implants). Marketed iFuse implant family is already FDA-cleared/PMA-approved; ongoing company-sponsored studies (SILVIA, PAULA, STACI, SAFFRON) are post-market real-world evidence / observational studies of cleared devices, not active P1/P2/P3 IDE pivotal registrational trials.
